description: Defines the Reminder class with properties and methods for managing reminder data, including time formatting logic.

classes.name: Reminder
classes.description: A class representing a reminder with properties such as title, description, time, priority, mode, recurrence, and snooze details, including a method to format time until the reminder.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the reminder.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the reminder.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the reminder.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the reminder.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of the reminder.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority level of the reminder.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the reminder.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the reminder.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the reminder (repeat, once, permanent).

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the reminder.

methods.name: getRecurringMode
methods.description: Returns the recurring mode (week, month, day, year).

methods.name: setRecurringMode
methods.description: Sets the recurring mode.

methods.name: getSelectedDays
methods.description: Returns the selected days for recurrence.

methods.name: setSelectedDays
methods.description: Sets the selected days for recurrence.

methods.name: isLocalOnly
methods.description: Checks if the reminder is local only.

methods.name: setLocalOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the reminder is local only.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the reminder is disabled.

methods.name: setDisabled
methods.description: Sets whether the reminder is disabled.

methods.name: getSnoozeUntil
methods.description: Returns the timestamp until which the reminder is snoozed.

methods.name: setSnoozeUntil
methods.description: Sets the snooze timestamp.

methods.name: getFormattedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted string of the reminder time.

methods.name: setFormattedTime
methods.description: Sets the formatted time string.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable string representing the time until the specified timestamp.
